items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 6:1
items.html: After the concluding Malchut ascended to the place of the Bina of the body, and before the coupling Malchut ascended to the Bina of the head, to the place of the coupling to bring out the stature of the Nekudim, in the meantime the vessels from the Chazeh downward fell below the conclusion of the feet of AK — that is, below the point of the conclusion of the first restriction. (Item 3).
